description: This file defines an interface for user repository operations such as retrieving users by ID, username, or email, adding new users, and saving changes, within a note management backend system.

classes.name: IUserRepository
classes.description: An interface for user data persistence operations specifying methods for retrieval, addition, and saving changes.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a user asynchronously by their unique identifier (GUID).

methods.name: GetByUsernameAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a user asynchronously by their username.

methods.name: GetByEmailAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a user asynchronously by their email address.

methods.name: AddAsync
methods.description: Adds a new user asynchronously to the repository.

methods.name: SaveChangesAsync
methods.description: Commits any pending changes asynchronously to the data store.
